1.consolidated_definition: En uso pronominal, el DRAE recoge en la 4ta acepción del verbo empaquetar: ‘emperijilarse, acicalarse una personas’. “Casi no la reconoció cuando se la encontró tan empaquetada en la fiesta.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: In pronominal use, the DRAE records in the 4th sense of the verb empaquetar: 'to preen oneself, to primp oneself as a person'. "He almost didn't recognize her when he found her so elaborately dressed at the party."
